visualCharacteristics.structure: 2 CTAs + 3 images + list (default); heading + text + 2 CTAs + 3 images + list (hero)
visualCharacteristics.purpose: image slider with dot indicators and prev/next controls; image-only on adventure detail pages, image + overlapping text card on homepages (hero)

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide: image cell, optional content cell (heading, text, CTAs)
contentPattern.default: image-only cell per row (adventure detail pages)
contentPattern.hero: image cell + content cell (heading, paragraph, CTA link) rendered as a card overlapping the bottom of the image

reuseGuidance: Use for 2+ rotating images or slides. A single row renders a static slide without controls. Add the hero option for homepage-style slides where each row has an image cell plus a text cell (heading, paragraph, CTA).
